By the following vote yeas Kinney, Schuber, Cook, Radkey, Kupping, Plath & Wilson Nays,
Bruggerhoff.

The resignation of D F Iglehart and
J A Cooper, as members of the Board of Equalization was received and accepted. Mayor
nominated J Warrenberger and Mr Brush to fill the vacancy.
The Council confirmed the nominations
After hearing some suggestions for and against alderman cook moved that the council
adjourn
On motion the Council adjourned
July 1. 1882
Thomas E. Purnell
City Clerk
Read and approved July 6. 1882

Regular Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas July 6 1882
Alderman Kinney in the Chair

Roll call present Metz Kinney, Cook and
Schuber,
A fine of one dollar was entered against
Aldermen Bruggerhoff, Radkey, Kupping, Moran Cook Plath and Wilson for non attendance at
this meeting.
On motion of Alderman schuber the
council was called and the marshal sent after the absentees,
On motion the Call of the Council
was sustained

And on motion of Alderman Metz
the Council adjourned
Thomas E. Purnell
City Clerk
